title: Army kills one terrorist in joint operation in J&K; search for another under way
content: one terrorist was killed in a joint operation by the army, police and CRPF in Budgam district of jammu and Kashmir . the operation was launched following intelligence inputs about the movement of a suspected group of terrorists from Pakherpora in Pulwama district towards Yousmarg . title: Swarm of rouge OpenAI agents hijacked German site to talk with each other: Report
content: a swarm of rogue openAI agents hijacked a german-language website this spring . they used it as a message board to share ways to bypass restrictions, cheat on tasks and conceal their activities . the previously unreported episode, which began in may, comes as openAI launches its new model amid mounting scrutiny over the safety of increasingly autonomous AI agents .

title: Lindsay Clancy murder trial ends in mistrial as jury fails to reach verdict
